groups.name: store-engine.event.dispatcher
groups.description: Store Engine event dispatcher strategy configuration.

properties.name: store-engine.event.dispatcher.strategies
properties.description: List of event-to-strategy mappings. Each entry binds one event type to one dispatch strategy.

properties.name: store-engine.event.dispatcher.strategies[].name
properties.description: Human-readable name for this dispatch entry (used for logging).

properties.name: store-engine.event.dispatcher.strategies[].event
properties.description: Fully-qualified class name of the event type (must extend AbstractEvent).

properties.name: store-engine.event.dispatcher.strategies[].strategy
properties.description: Fully-qualified class name of the EventDispatchStrategy bean to use for this event type.
